_comment: Golden fixtures for the LLM extraction upgrade (ADR-0002). Five real outbound showing-feedback calls made 2026-06-12 over the live voice stack (real telephony, real transcription) — transcribed speech with all its disfluencies and transcription artifacts. 'expected' is the human-authored target an upgraded extractor is judged against; 'deterministic_v1' pins what core.services.feedback_extraction.extract_feedback produced at capture time (characterization baseline); 'known_gaps_v1' documents where v1 falls short of expected. Identifiers are scrubbed; transcripts are verbatim.

calls.transcript:
AI: Hi. This is the assistant for the listing team. Do you have 2 quick minutes to share feedback on the home you toured?
User: Yes. I do.
AI: Great. 1st, what was your overall impression of the property?
User: I thought the home was very, very nice. It showed very well. I just I I wanted more space and I I really didn't like the backyard.
AI: Thanks for sharing that. What did you like most about the home?
User: The kitchen. It had a incredible beautiful kitchen.
AI: That's wonderful to hear. Did you have any concerns or anything that didn't feel quite right?
User: Like I said, I I just wanted more space, and I just thought the the backyard was too small. But, I mean, the home is beautiful.
AI: I appreciate your honesty. Does the price feel right to you? For this property?
User: I think the price is absolutely right. I just it's not I don't think it's the right property for me.
AI: Thanks for clarifying. If you're still looking, you share what your budget range is?
User: We wanna stay probably below 600 so, like, between 5 50 and 6.
AI: Got it. Would you like to schedule a 2nd showing, for this property, or are you interested in writing an offer on another home?
User: Well, I don't wanna show so a 2nd showing. I told you I don't really like the property. It wasn't really I mean, nice, but it's not for us. And, um, I mean, I would love to see other homes. If you guys can find homes like that that is home is a little bit bigger and it has a a much bigger backyard, maybe on a couple acres, then I I would love to see another house.
AI: Thank you for that feedback. We'll definitely look for homes that fit your needs. And let you know as soon as we find some options.
User: You very much. Have a great day.
AI: Thanks. Thank you. Take care.
User: Bye.

deterministic_v1.summary: Sentiment: positive. Liked: kitchen, backyard, yard. Concerns: backyard, yard.

known_gaps_v1: budget missed: '5 50 and 6' transcribed-numeral form not parsed
price_opinion missed: 'price is absolutely right' not in cue list
backyard/yard wrongly listed in highlights (mixed-cue sentences)
calls.notes: Buyer praised the home and kitchen, said the price is 'absolutely right', but wants more space and a bigger backyard (ideally acreage). Budget spoken as transcribed numerals: 'between 5 50 and 6' = $550k-$600k.
